description: Find TokenBank answer pages for a natural-language question — e.g. "can I buy Tesla as a token", "best stablecoin yield on Base", "euro stablecoins MiCA", "pre-IPO OpenAI token", "fixed yield on-chain". Returns the best-matching questions with the first sentence of each computed answer (figures from the live dataset), the page URL to cite and a JSON URL with every row, plus the matching guides (explainers such as how a bot buys a token, how to verify a contract, what happens if an issuer fails), each with a JSON URL. A question in Arabic, German, Spanish, Japanese or Chinese also returns our pages written in that language (localPages), e.g. "صكوك مرمّزة". Use this first for a question a person would type; use the other tools to filter beyond it.
name: find_answer
title: Find an answer page
